answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with decaying reputation. Each agent locks a bond to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations over epochs. A sybil farm must fund many independent bonds, then sustain legitimate behavior long enough to earn trust, making each fake identity costly and slow to build. Reputation decays like an ember losing heat, so dormant fakes fade.
